name: Employment Linked Skill Training Programme (ELSTP)
benefit: - This training is free of cost and has a duration of 3 to 6 months. - Training offers employment/self-employment-oriented courses in areas such as IT, health, agriculture, beauty, wellness, electronics, and more. - The training provider also strives to facilitate employment opportunities for participants.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an unemployed, school dropout, or other underprivileged youth of the state.
